args.summary:
Cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box-girder bridge, 3 spans (36+48+36 m, bearing centre-lines), deck width 16 m, modelled as a 2D spine beam (MR-01) on a continuous-on-piers system (MR-05) since pier column geometry is given.

Model decisions:
- Section: single-cell cast_box, B_top=16 m, B_bot=9 m, h=2.4 m, t_top=0.25, t_bot=0.22, t_web=0.45, cantilever root/tip 0.5/0.2 m. Integrated properties A=8.417 m², I=7.188 m⁴ (MR-02).
- Material: C50, Ec=34500 MPa (JTG3362-3.1.5); γ=26.0 kN/m³ (JTGD60-4.2.1); w=γA=218.84 kN/m, m=w/g=22.31 t/m (MR-07), girder self-weight only.
- Bearings (2 per line, MR-04): Abutments 0 & 3 and Pier 2 = PTFE sliding (longitudinally free, Kh=0); Pier 1 = plain laminated elastomeric (fixed, Kh=13091 kN/m). Vertical spring stiffnesses from JTG3362-8.7: Kv = 3.61e6 kN/m (abutments), 8.97e6 kN/m (Pier 1), 8.08e6 kN/m (Pier 2); shape factors S=10.10, 14.69, 13.54 respectively; manufacturer Ge=1.2 MPa used (MR-00 override).
- Piers (MR-06): twin 1.6 m dia C40 columns, Ec=32500 MPa; A=4.021 m², I=0.6434 m⁴; Pier 1 H=8 m, Pier 2 H=11 m, bases fixed.
- Live load: Highway Class I; one-way, 4 design lanes, ξ=0.67; qk=10.5 kN/m; Pk=332/356/332 kN for spans 1/2/3 (JTG D60-4.3.1).

Results: f1 = 2.980 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.177 (JTG D60-4.3.2). Self-weight reactions ≈ 2835/10302/10281/2843 kN; max self-weight span moment 23.42 MN·m; lane-load max positive moment 14.36 MN·m and max negative moment −11.48 MN·m. The OpenSeesPy model passed all L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks. No unresolved issues.
